title: The quasi-finite locus is open
statement: Let $f:X\to S$ be a morphism of schemes. Using quasi-finiteness in the sense of [pqf-def-quasifinite], the set of points of $X$ at which $f$ is quasi-finite is an open subset $U\subseteq X$, and the induced morphism $U\to S$ is locally quasi-finite.
